cases.name: advertised_profile_closure
cases.expected: All inherited required endpoints, schemas, event kinds, bindings, fixtures, and required feature-discovery tokens are advertised or locally available. push_gateway requires only notify plus its blind-wakeup dependency, not Account registration operations or PCR Event execution.

cases.name: surface_tier_does_not_overclaim
cases.expected: The service does not advertise an operation, profile, or schema excluded by its declared surface tier or role. station.push contains exactly register_device and unregister_device; push_gateway.http_notify contains exactly notify. Co-located roles retain separate role-scoped describe claims.
